versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Finding Brand Collaborations on TikTok skill.

- Enables discovery of brand-influencer collaborations and sponsored content patterns on TikTok.
- Outputs creator handle, brand name, post performance, estimated reach, and collaboration frequency.
- Supports searching by profile URLs, hashtags, keywords, and regional filters.
- Includes analysis steps for extracting brand-creator pairs, campaign scoring, and handling ambiguous or undisclosed sponsorships.
- Designed for influencer marketing, competitive intelligence, and brand partnership tracking.
